Housing51021**00; terminal families500798*00/500588*00. Drawing does not establish electrical ratings or finished-cable polarity/fit. Title block: PICOBLADE 1.25 HEADER ASSY DIP VT TIN PLATING TYPE, 530470000-SD, PSD 000 rev B, sheet 1 of 2, release 2022/04/19. Added 2026-11-12 from a copy the owner downloaded from molex.com and attached in the project thread (199246 bytes, PDF CreationDate 2022-04-19); its SHA-256 equals this record's 76d2a581..., so these are the same bytes. Dimension read visually from a 200 dpi render of sheet 1.

sources.document_title: Molex PicoBlade 1.25 wire-to-board connector system product specification (single-row vertical TH, tin plating)
sources.retained_bytes: none in the repository (713285 bytes, 16 pages, file name 510211110-PS-000.pdf); re-download and compare the hash
sources.authority_note: Downloaded by the owner from molex.com in their own browser and attached in the project thread on 2026-11-12; the exact download URL was not recorded, so the Molex part page that links the specification is given. The cloud VM could not fetch molex.com (HTTP/2 stream reset). Scope (sheet 3 of 16): the specification covers Plug Assembly (Vertical Type) 53047**10, drawing 530470000-SD, which includes 530470310 (3 circuits). The owner also attached 510211010-PS rev B (2021-06-25, SHA-256 1b2a28845d4bad6663889edc99de8ddb9df1b2cedc7f81d98f15ab55cf76e9a0), an older single-row TH specification that also lists 53047**10 and prints the same voltage, current, temperature and durability values; this record uses the newer vertical-only revision. Ratings do not qualify the finished cable or the board.
sources.locator: 510211110-PS sheet 4 of 16, section 4.1 VOLTAGE, 4.2 RATED CURRENT AND APPLICABLE WIRES, 4.3 CURRENT DERATING
sources.evidence_extract: 4.1 VOLTAGE: 125 V AC rms / DC. 4.2 Rated current (MAX.): AWG #26 1.0 A, AWG #28 1.0 A, AWG #30 1.0 A, AWG #32 0.8 A; insulation O.D. 500588001 0.5-1.0 mm, 500798001 0.5-1.04 mm. 4.3 Current derating (reference only, 30 C temperature rise, all circuits powered) for 2 / 8 / 15 circuits: AWG26 2.5 / 1.5 / 1.0 A; AWG28 2.0 / 1.5 / 1.0 A; AWG30 1.5 / 1.0 / 1.0 A; AWG32 1.5 / 1.0 / 0.8 A; no 3-circuit column. Scope on sheet 3: 53047**10 Plug Assembly (Vertical Type), drawing 530470000-SD.
